issues: Lilly's original number-of-wives rules allow legal spouses, repeated ceremonies, nonmarital sweethearts and concubines to count as different outcomes; they are not interchangeable data.

Moon in the seventh is claimed to predict more than one Wife, yet author admits it did not always give two legal wives; the self-report shifts to female friends or concubines, preventing unambiguous scoring.
The author's 'never knew the Native failed' report is retrospective with no denominator, complete cases or transparent misses.
Moon conjoined exactly one planet is alleged to indicate one wife, a potentially conflicting count with the Moon-in-seventh rule.
Relative Moon-versus-aspecting-planet strength is used to claim order of death of husband versus wife; it is unverified and not legitimate health, safety or lifespan advice.
The number count based on Moon applying partile to eligible direct noncombust planets excludes Sun and requires application in the correct direction.
When qualifying planets occupy fruitful signs, the source doubles their number: another flexible alternative with no predetermined priority against other rules.
The one-form or bicorporeal Moon method is attributed to Ptolemy by Lilly; Ptolemy's original source text has not yet been collated here.

Additional fallback counts depend on planets between Midheaven and Venus or partile aspects to Lord Seventh, with inconsistent retrogradation/combustion eligibility depending on dignity or method choice.
Lilly claims his best experienced method counts Moon-sign applying planets, or alternatively dignity-bearing aspecting planets, with no auditable prospective test.
Weak marriage significators are explicitly said to imply courtship, affairs and sweethearts instead of actual wives; this is an alternative target, not confirmation.
Two- or three-wife rules from common, fruitful/bicorporeal Moon and planet signs can overlap multiple other counting methods.
The author calls the compounded fruitful seventh-house three-wife result certain, but offers no independent marriage register or sample of people with or without it.
No single deterministic algorithm, planet-count weights, historical aspect orb thresholds or birth-time uncertainty rule has been finalized.
No independent legal-marriage certificates, personal relationship histories, partner data, calendar periods or matched controls were inspected for this source batch.
